👤 CREATE A NEW FMS USER

Use this procedure when a new employee needs an FMS login.

Before you start: Confirm the request/authority, correct site/company and the exact record or user you are working on. Do not make an unapproved change.
1
Before startingCHECK the value before changing anything
Confirm the employee's approved request. Collect full name, employee/ID number, email, department, site/branch, job function, required role, start date and end date if access is temporary. Confirm the request has the required manager/system-owner approval. ACTUAL FMS2 SCREEN supplied by you — this is not a mock-up.
📸 VISUAL GUIDE — FOLLOW THE RED ARROWS
AI training visual based on the supplied FMS layout. Use the highlighted menu/button/field as the guide; wording or screen placement may differ in your live FMS.
2

Open the approved FMS2 address. Sign in with your authorised IT/FMS administrator account. Confirm that you are in the correct site/company before making changes.

AI training visual based on the supplied FMS layout. Use the highlighted menu/button/field as the guide; wording or screen placement may differ in your live FMS.

AI training visual based on the supplied FMS layout. Use the highlighted menu/button/field as the guide; wording or screen placement may differ in your live FMS.

Search for the employee before creating anything. Check username, employee number and email. This prevents duplicate accounts.

AI training visual based on the supplied FMS layout. Use the highlighted menu/button/field as the guide; wording or screen placement may differ in your live FMS.
